Name: Sharezer
Summary: Sharezer was a son of Sennacherib who, with his brother Adrammelech, murdered his father in the house of Nisroch and fled to Ararat.
KeyStory: Sharezer and Adrammelech killed Sennacherib as he worshipped, and Esar-haddon his son reigned in his place.
LifeLesson: Violence sown by an empire is often reaped inside its own house.
